Title: Sign in with valid credentials
Preconditions: Registered account exists; tester signed out
Steps: Open login page; enter valid email and password; select Sign in
Expected Result: User lands on the dashboard signed in as that account

Title: Sign in with wrong password shows a generic error
Preconditions: Registered account exists; tester signed out
Steps: Open login page; enter valid email and wrong password; select Sign in
Expected Result: Generic error that does not reveal which field was wrong; user stays on login page

Title: Account locks after repeated failures per policy
Steps: Submit wrong password the policy number of times; then try the correct password
Expected Result: Account locks for the policy duration; correct password refused while locked with a clear message

Title: Password reset link works once only
Steps: Use the reset link to set a new password; open the same link again
Expected Result: Second use is refused: the link is dead after first use
Actual Result: Link opened the reset form again and accepted a second change; see DEF-001

Title: Search appointments by provider
Preconditions: Signed in; two providers have open slots
Expected Result: Only provider A appointments are returned

Title: Book the last open slot then search again
Preconditions: One slot remains for a provider and date
Steps: Book the last slot; search the same provider and date again

Title: Two sessions book the same slot at the same time
Preconditions: One slot open; two signed-in sessions
Steps: Open the slot in both sessions; confirm booking in both within seconds
Expected Result: Second confirmation fails with a clear message; exactly one booking exists
Actual Result: Both confirmations succeeded; two bookings exist; see DEF-002

Title: Cancel a booking and the slot reopens
Steps: Cancel the booking; search the slot again

Title: Book an appointment in the past by hand-editing the request
Steps: Send a booking request with a past date
Expected Result: Server rejects with 400 and a clear message

Title: Session times out during booking and resumes safely
Steps: Wait for the session timeout; sign in again; check bookings
Expected Result: No partial or duplicate booking; user can restart cleanly
